title: Evaluation preserved by conversion to a DAG
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs that uses only the standard gate operations, and let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to its inputs. The Boolean value computed by the directed acyclic circuit obtained from $F$, viewed as an element of $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$, equals the value computed by $F$ at its unique output, under the input assignment obtained by encoding each Boolean value as its corresponding element of $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
